mapper.select: SELECT id FROM nw_chat_sessions WHERE tenant_id::text=#{scope} AND session_id=#{sessionId}
SELECT authorization_version FROM nw_foundation_access_scopes WHERE scope_key=#{scope}

choose.when: SELECT m.id,m.username,coalesce(p.display_name,m.display_name,m.username) AS display_name,m.email,m.status, p.department_id,p.position_id,coalesce(p.authorization_version,1) AS authorization_version, coalesce(p.lock_version,1) AS lock_version,m.created_at FROM nw_platform_members m LEFT JOIN nw_foundation_member_profiles p ON p.scope_key=#{scope} AND p.member_id=m.id WHERE m.id=#{memberId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT m.id,m.username,coalesce(p.display_name,m.username) AS display_name,m.email, CASE WHEN t.status IN('active','warning') THEN m.status ELSE 'disabled' END AS status, p.department_id,p.position_id,coalesce(p.authorization_version,1) AS authorization_version, coalesce(p.lock_version,1) AS lock_version,m.created_at FROM nw_tenant_members m JOIN nw_tenants t ON t.id=m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN nw_foundation_member_profiles p ON p.scope_key=#{scope} AND p.member_id=m.id WHERE m.id=#{memberId} AND m.tenant_id::text=#{scope}

mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.code,r.name,r.data_scope,r.built_in,r.administrator,r.enabled,r.lock_version FROM nw_foundation_roles r JOIN nw_foundation_member_roles mr ON mr.scope_key=r.scope_key AND mr.role_id=r.id WHERE mr.scope_key=#{scope} AND mr.member_id=#{memberId} AND r.enabled ORDER BY r.code

SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_code FROM nw_foundation_role_permissions rp JOIN nw_foundation_roles r ON r.scope_key=rp.scope_key AND r.id=rp.role_id AND r.enabled JOIN nw_foundation_member_roles mr ON mr.scope_key=r.scope_key AND mr.role_id=r.id WHERE mr.scope_key=#{scope} AND mr.member_id=#{memberId} ORDER BY rp.permission_code

SELECT DISTINCT d.id FROM nw_foundation_role_departments rd JOIN nw_foundation_roles r ON r.scope_key=rd.scope_key AND r.id=rd.role_id AND r.enabled AND r.data_scope='specified' JOIN nw_foundation_member_roles mr ON mr.scope_key=r.scope_key AND mr.role_id=r.id JOIN nw_foundation_departments d ON d.scope_key=rd.scope_key AND d.id=rd.department_id AND d.enabled WHERE mr.scope_key=#{scope} AND mr.member_id=#{memberId}

WITH RECURSIVE tree AS ( SELECT id FROM nw_foundation_departments WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{departmentId} AND enabled UNION ALL SELECT d.id FROM nw_foundation_departments d JOIN tree t ON d.parent_id=t.id WHERE d.scope_key=#{scope} AND d.enabled ) SELECT id FROM tree
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_departments WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{departmentId} AND enabled)

SELECT kind,resource_id::text AS resource_id,owner_member_id,department_id,lock_version FROM nw_foundation_resource_ownership WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND kind=#{kind} AND resource_id=#{resourceId}::bigint

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_resource_grants g WHERE g.scope_key=#{scope} AND g.kind=#{kind} AND g.resource_id=#{resourceId}::bigint AND g.action=#{action} AND ((g.grantee_type='member' AND g.grantee_id=#{memberId}) OR (g.grantee_type='department' AND g.grantee_id=#{departmentId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_departments d WHERE d.scope_key=#{scope} AND d.id=g.grantee_id AND d.enabled)) OR (g.grantee_type='role' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_member_roles mr JOIN nw_foundation_roles r ON r.scope_key=mr.scope_key AND r.id=mr.role_id AND r.enabled WHERE mr.scope_key=#{scope} AND mr.member_id=#{memberId} AND mr.role_id=g.grantee_id))))
